updateTokenGatedDrop(address,(uint80,uin.notice: Updates the token gated drop stage for the nft contract         and emits an event.         This method assume msg.sender is an nft contract and its         ERC165 interface id matches INonFungibleSeaDropToken.         Note: Be sure only authorized users can call this from         token contracts that implement INonFungibleSeaDropToken.         Note: If two INonFungibleSeaDropToken tokens are doing         simultaneous token gated drop promotions for each other,         they can be minted by the same actor until         `maxTokenSupplyForStage` is reached.
